sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Students complete 120 units, as specified below

sections.note: The program consists of courses in world literature (WL courses).

sections.title: Lower Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete a total of 21 units.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor

sections.note:
Students complete a total of 21 units, including.
one 100-level WL writing course
Students may count one 2nd year language course (three units) toward their lower division WL units.

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Students complete a minimum total of 32 upper division WL units
Check with an advisor
requirements.text: 24 additional upper division WL units, of which at least eight must be taken at the 400-level.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: SFU-Exeter accelerated law dual degree program students complete the same requirements except they may replace four units of 400-level coursework with four units of 300-level coursework in world literature.

sections.note:
Students complete a minimum total of 32 upper division WL units including both of.
For students in this program, 300-level WL courses will have a prerequisite of 30 units instead of 45.
To view full requirements for this program, please see https://www.sfu.ca/students/calendar/faculties-research/faculty-arts-social-sciences/ba-alp.html .

sections.title: Relevant Topic Courses

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: With prior approval, students may complete a maximum of three lower and eight upper division units of relevant topic courses from outside the World Literature Program (courses offered at Simon Fraser University or our field schools and exchanges) by submitting the course description to the World Literature advisor.

sections.note: The following pre-approved courses are appropriate.

sections.title: Study Abroad

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: World literature major students may complete up to 15 upper division units at other universities or other universities' field schools and exchanges with prior approval.

sections.note:
Students are encouraged to study abroad, through field schools or exchanges.
Submit the relevant course description to the world literature advisor well in advance of the course.

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.
